questions.text:
Consider the following sequence of operations on an empty stack.

push(54); push(52); pop(); push(55); push(62); s=pop();

Consider the following sequence of operations on an empty queue.

enqueue(21); enqueue(24); dequeue(); enqueue(28); enqueue(32); q=dequeue();

The value of s+q is ___________.
questions.solution:
Stack: push 54, push 52, pop (52), push 55, push 62, pop [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] s = 62.
Queue: enqueue 21, 24, dequeue (21), enqueue 28, 32, dequeue [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] q = 24.

s + q = 86

Answer: 86

questions.text:
Consider a computer system with a byte-addressable primary memory of size [latex]2^{32} \text{ bytes}[/latex]. Assume the computer system has a direct-mapped cache of size [latex]32 KB (1 KB = 2^{10} \text{ bytes})[/latex], and each cache block is of size 64 bytes.
The size of the tag field is __________ bits.
questions.solution:
Lines = 32 KB / 64 B = 512 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 9 index bits. Offset = 6 bits.

Tag = 32 [latex]-[/latex] 9 [latex]-[/latex] 6 = 17 bits

Answer: 17

questions.text:
A relation [latex]r(A,B)[/latex] in a relational database has 1200 tuples. The attribute [latex]A[/latex] has integer values ranging from 6 to 20, and the attribute [latex]B[/latex] has integer values ranging from 1 to 20. Assume that the attributes [latex]A[/latex] and [latex]B[/latex] are independently distributed.

The estimated number of tuples in the output of [latex]\sigma _{(A > 10)\vee(B=18)}(r)[/latex] is ____________
questions.solution:
A takes 15 values (6-20) and B takes 20 values (1-20). The official key accepts two answers, depending on what is counted.

Method 1: estimated tuples in the output = 820
- A [latex]\gt[/latex] 10 holds for 11-20, 10 of 15 values [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]P=\frac23[/latex]
- [latex]P(B=18)=\frac1{20}[/latex]
- Independent: [latex]P(A \gt 10\vee B=18)=\frac23+\frac1{20}-\frac23\cdot\frac1{20}=\frac{41}{60}[/latex]
- Estimated tuples [latex]=1200\times\frac{41}{60}=820[/latex]

Method 2: distinct (A, B) value pairs that satisfy the condition = 205
- A [latex]\gt[/latex] 10 with any B: [latex]10\times20=200[/latex] pairs
- B = 18 with A [latex]\le[/latex] 10 (A = 6-10): 5 more pairs
- Total [latex]=200+5=205[/latex]

Answer: 820 (estimated tuples) or 205 (distinct value pairs); both are accepted

questions.text:
Consider the following representation of a number in IEEE 754 single-precision floating point format with a bias of 127.

S:1
E:10000001
F:11110000000000000000000

Here, S,E and F denote the sign, exponent, and fraction components of the floating point representation.

The decimal value corresponding to the above representation (rounded to 2 decimal places) is ____________.
questions.solution:
Exponent = 129 [latex]-[/latex] 127 = 2. Mantissa = 1.1111[latex]{}_2[/latex] = 1 + 0.5 + 0.25 + 0.125 + 0.0625 = 1.9375. Sign 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] negative.

Value [latex]=-1.9375\times2^2=-7.75[/latex]

Answer: -7.75
